title: OminChat
tagline: A modern general-purpose conversational AI assistant
shortDescription: A modern conversational AI assistant with real-time streaming, multi-chat conversations, reusable prompt templates, rich AI responses, configurable generation settings, and a responsive user experience.
fullDescription: OmniChat is a modern general-purpose conversational AI application designed to provide a polished, responsive experience for interacting with large language models. The platform combines real-time streaming conversations with multi-chat management, searchable conversation history, reusable prompt templates, configurable generation controls, Markdown and code rendering, and responsive support across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

features.title: Real-Time AI Streaming
features.description: AI responses are progressively streamed into the conversation to create a responsive, real-time interaction experience.

features.title: Multi-Conversation Management
features.description: Users can create, switch between, search, and delete independent conversations.

features.title: Persistent Chat History
features.description: Conversation data is automatically persisted locally so users can return to previous conversations.

features.title: Conversation data is automatically persisted locally so users can return to previous conversations.
features.description: Users can configure supported model settings, temperature, maximum token limits, and streaming behavior.

features.title: Prompt Template Library
features.description: A categorized collection of reusable prompts helps users quickly start common development, writing, learning, and creative workflows.

features.title: Rich AI Responses
features.description: AI output supports Markdown formatting, structured content, syntax-highlighted code, and one-click code copying.

features.title: Responsive Interface
features.description: The application adapts to desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes with responsive navigation and layouts.

features.title: Dark & Light Themes
features.description: Users can switch between dark and light visual themes for a personalized experience.

features.title: Conversation Export
features.description: Users can export conversations as text for external use or archiving.

challenge.summary: Creating a useful conversational AI application requires more than connecting a frontend to an LLM API. The challenge was to build a complete and polished chat experience capable of handling real-time generation, multiple conversations, persistent state, configurable AI behavior, reusable prompts, rich content rendering, and responsive interaction.
points: Design a modern conversational AI interface
Create a reusable prompt template system
Support responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts
Provide reliable loading, error, and delete-confirmation states
Keep the architecture modular and extensible for future AI capabilities

solution.summary: OmniChat was implemented as a modular Next.js application with centralized conversation state management, a dedicated AI service layer, reusable UI components, and client-side persistence. The architecture separates the chat interface, application state, AI integration, content rendering, and supporting functionality, providing a foundation that can be extended into more advanced AI systems.
points: Created a dedicated AI service layer for LLM communication
Built the application with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
Implemented streaming and non-streaming AI responses
Centralized chat and settings state using React Context
Added Markdown and syntax-highlighted code rendering
Structured the application for future RAG, tool-use, agentic workflows, and multi-model capabilities
